author: Jane Austen
text: There is a stubbornness about me that never can bear to be frightened at the will of others. My courage always rises at every attempt to intimidate me.

author: John Donne
text: No man is an Iland, intire of it selfe; every man is a peece of the Continent, a part of the maine

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: Very little is needed to make a happy life.

author: Leo Tolstoy
citation: War and Peace (trans. Louise and Aylmer Maude)
text: The two most powerful warriors are patience and time.
